opportunities.name: Ryanair round-trip flight search
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for a return flight between a given origin and destination airport with given depart/return dates and passenger count, then select outbound and return flights.
steps: Click From and pick origin country/airport (or type it)
Click To and pick destination country/airport
Pick depart date in calendar (navigate month if needed)
Open Passengers and set adults, click Done
Select outbound flight and return flight

instances.values: Dublin->Athens, 2 Apr to 5 Apr, 1 adult, selected both flights
Tel Aviv->Venice Treviso, 9 May to 16 May, 1 adult, selected both flights
Dublin->Paris Beauvais, 26 Apr to 2 May, 2 adults, promo code 1000001

opportunities.description: Search Resy for a restaurant by name/cuisine (optionally changing city), open its page, set party size/date, and click Notify for a meal time window.
steps: Optionally change city via location button
Type restaurant name or cuisine in search box
Set guests and date if needed

instances.values: thai -> Senyai Thai Kitchen, Dinner notify 5-7 PM, 2 guests
high tide -> High Tide (New York), date Apr 17, 2 guests, Lunch notify

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com Attractions for a destination and date, then open an attraction and view availability/tickets.
steps: Type destination (or pick from Explore destinations)
Open date picker and choose date
Optionally apply filters (category, free cancellation, city) and sort
Open attraction and click See availability / choose date and ticket counts, click Next

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris, 5 May, opened attraction ticket panel
Kyoto via Explore Asia, 25 May, filters Tours/free cancellation/Kyoto, Most popular, Fushimi Inari Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant
